verdict.rationale: mParticle is a customer data platform that ships AI-assisted audience features, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack contains no statement or control about excluding customer data from AI model training. The GDPR/CCPA consent controls, consent filters and data-sale opt-out forwarding rules are adjacent privacy features. They govern forwarding to downstream partners, not use of data for AI training, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
